name: laflhai-wallet-service
description: Backend wallet/ledger + ProviderRouter + CinetPay + eSIM/satellite pour LAFLHAI

scripts.migrate: node -e "require('dotenv').config(); const {Pool}=require('pg'); const fs=require('fs'); const p=new Pool({connectionString:process.env.DATABASE_URL}); p.query(fs.readFileSync('./sql/schema.sql','utf8')).then(()=>{console.log('Migration OK');process.exit(0)}).catch(e=>{console.error(e);process.exit(1)})"
scripts.seed: node -e "require('dotenv').config(); const {Pool}=require('pg'); const fs=require('fs'); const p=new Pool({connectionString:process.env.DATABASE_URL}); p.query(fs.readFileSync('./sql/seed.sql','utf8')).then(()=>{console.log('Seed OK');process.exit(0)}).catch(e=>{console.error(e);process.exit(1)})"
